ctx.x: sing. She just had that talent.

And he had... I remember at the Uptown Cotton Club, Wallace Beery came in. And he just did a show, a big movie -- and the house came down! They used to have that Sunday night up at the Cotton Club. And all the big entertainers, when they'd come in town, they'd come to the Cotton Club uptown. Because it was big. And Wallace Beery, he got a big hand when he stood up, and all he said, "Oh..." He got such a big ovation, and he said, "Oh, gee," -- the same thing he used to say in the pictures. And the house broke down…

They protected us, boy. They loved that band. But see, we improved the shows at the Cotton Club. Now, all respects to Duke Ellington. See, Duke Ellington... It was hard for us when we into the show, because he did a lot of his tunes in the show, and we had to get to the spot where we had to play for the dancers... We didn't have none of their music.
